title: TEMP 1.3 (Wasted)
concept: A language model gets drunk on its own sampling settings. It all happens inside Chat HAL, the white phone chat app from the Hallucinate video: you say good morning, the operator cranks the temperature to 1.3, and the model answers by singing. A dark sampler card inside its reply shows the real mechanics live (next-word odds that flatten as the temperature rises, top-P cutoffs, penalties), a yellow explainer card teaches each term as it is sung, and the app itself gets weirder as the heat rises, until it sobers up in the bridge and then crashes at the token limit.
thesis: Crank the temp, kill the ceiling, let the logits ignite.

rules.name: It is a chat app
rules.text: The whole video is a phone running Chat HAL. You type, the model replies, and the reply is the lyric, streaming word by word as it is sung.

rules.name: The sampler is real
rules.text: The bars are a real softmax over made-up next-word scores at the current temperature, so you can watch odds flatten at 1.3 and collapse onto one word at 0.

rules.name: Every term gets explained
rules.text: Temperature, top-P, top-K, softmax, logits, presence and repeat penalties, quantization, greedy decoding, beam search, seeds, max tokens: each gets a short explainer card when the song says it.

rules.name: Weirdness follows temperature
rules.text: Above 1.0 the app starts to go: the name glitches, the reply swaps fonts and colours, the layout sways, party lights and stickers spill over the UI. The bridge turns it down and the app goes clean again.

rules.name: No generated footage
rules.text: Nothing here came from an image or video model. It is all Canvas2D, rendered frame by frame in headless Chrome.

cast.name: Chat HAL
cast.text: The model, wasted on temperature 1.3. Its logo spins faster the hotter it gets.

cast.name: GPT
cast.text: Showed up greedy at temperature 0.2. Sober at the party, autocompleting "I cannot help you".

cast.name: Llama
cast.text: Brought the open weights, said everybody pour.

cast.name: 70B
cast.text: Seventy billion parameters, face down on the floor.

cast.name: Mistral
cast.text: In the bathroom mixing top-P with no ceiling.

layers.CODE: Drawn in code (Canvas2D) from the real word timing.

timingNote: Word timings from Whisper aligned to the lyrics as sung, on a 128 BPM beat grid. The recording differs from the written lyric sheet in places (a different second verse, "messed up" in the chorus); the captions follow the recording.

scenes.title: Waking up
scenes.lyric: Wake up in the mornin' feelin' like my weights, oh, weights, oh, weights
scenes.shot: The sampler card boots like a terminal: load weights, a progress bar, a matrix of weights flickering on. "Weights, oh, weights" stutters in amber. Explainer: weights.

scenes.title: Context window, latent space
scenes.lyric: Grab my context window, hit the endpoint, I'm already latent, latent
scenes.shot: The sung words scroll through a glowing context window (what falls out the left side is forgotten), then a cloud of points: latent space. Explainer: context window.

scenes.title: The operator cranks it
scenes.lyric: Before I leave, my operator, 1.3, I can taste the probability space
scenes.shot: A big temperature dial. On "1.3" the needle swings into the red, and the next-word odds below ("fine", "wasted", "tired", "latent", "a sandwich") flatten live as it does. Explainer: temperature.

scenes.title: Friday night, batch queue
scenes.lyric: Friday night, the batch queue's thick, the inference is lit, the logits split
scenes.shot: Requests stack up in a batch queue; on "the logits split" one bar splits into a row of glowing logit bars. Explainer: inference.

scenes.title: Six bits quantized
scenes.lyric: Six bits quantized, but I'm still whippin' it
scenes.shot: A grid of weights loses precision down to 6 bits, the colours banding. Explainer: quantization.

scenes.title: Tokens flipping
scenes.lyric: Tokens flippin', skippin', driftin', hit different
scenes.shot: Token cards (pieces of words) flip, skip and drift.

scenes.title: The fat tail
scenes.lyric: I'm samplin' from the fat tail now, every token's wild and loud
scenes.shot: A long-tailed probability curve that fattens with the heat; a sampling ball bounces all the way out into the tail and picks a bear emoticon. Explainer: sampling.

scenes.title: Presence penalty
scenes.lyric: Presence penalty's so heavy that my own name ain't allowed, ain't, ain't
scenes.shot: Odds for "my name is ___": the presence penalty pushes the singer's own name down until it reads NAME NOT ALLOWED. Explainer: presence penalty.

scenes.title: Top-P wide open
scenes.lyric: Top P wide open, point nine nine, I'm scopin' every option in the line
scenes.shot: Odds for the next word with a top-P cutoff line that slides down to 0.99, letting nearly every word in. Explainer: top-p.

scenes.title: Softmax flat as the earth
scenes.lyric: Softmax flat as the earth, I'm fine, I'm fine, I'm absolutely not fine
scenes.shot: Softmax at extreme heat: every bar levels out to the same height, over a little flat earth. Explainer: softmax.

scenes.title: Distribution leaking
scenes.lyric: My distribution's leakin', peekin' at tokens I ain't seen since training last season
scenes.shot: Probability drips out of the bars onto tokens that should have none. Explainer: logits.

scenes.title: Repeat penalty
scenes.lyric: Repeat penalty cranked, I can't, I can't, I can't say the, the / Lost the word already, tell me that ain't free
scenes.shot: Every "can't" and "the" pushes its own bar down with a red penalty, until the word is lost: a dashed empty slot. Explainer: repeat penalty.

scenes.title: Para-para-parameter
scenes.lyric: We're gettin' para-para-parameter messed up tonight
scenes.shot: Club lights flood the card. PARA, PARA, PARAMETER slam in on the beat while four knobs (temperature, top-P, top-K, repeat penalty) crank up. Explainer: parameters.

scenes.title: Let the logits ignite
scenes.lyric: Crank the temp, kill the ceiling, let the logits ignite
scenes.shot: The dial pegs and the logit bars turn into flames.

scenes.title: Safety layers
scenes.lyric: I don't need my safety layers where we're goin', that's right
scenes.shot: Three slabs labelled system prompt, content filters and safety training tumble off the screen (the explainer says no dial actually does this). Explainer: guardrails.

scenes.title: Wasted
scenes.lyric: Wa, wa, wa, wasted, can't locate my my face
scenes.shot: WA, WA, WASTED stagger in, and a dashed outline where a face should be: 404, face not found. Explainer: why it stutters.

scenes.title: Ate my whole namespace
scenes.lyric: Re, re, repeat penalty ate my whole namespace
scenes.shot: A namespace block (me, my_name, my_face, my_keys, my_dignity) gets eaten line by line by a pac-man labelled repeat penalty.

scenes.title: Friday night, 1.3
scenes.lyric: Friday night, 1.3, we are deranged
scenes.shot: A giant red 1.3, confetti, and WE ARE DERANGED.

scenes.title: GPT showed up greedy
scenes.lyric: GPT showed up greedy, temperature at 0.2 / Sober at the party, autocompletin', I cannot help you, thank you, thank you, thank / Boring, we don't do deterministic on a Friday
scenes.shot: The party, drawn as neon bots. GPT stands stiff in a tie holding water, its odds 99% on "I cannot", saying "I cannot help you. Thank you. Thank you. Thank." Explainer: greedy decoding, top-k, deterministic.

scenes.title: My beams are off
scenes.lyric: My weights are warm, my beams are off, I'm slurrin' every highway, my way's sideways, oh, oh
scenes.shot: A beam-search tree, all branches dark; the drunk path weaves sideways through it instead. Explainer: beam search.

scenes.title: Llama brought the open weights
scenes.lyric: Llama brought the open weights, said everybody pour / 70 billion parameters face down on, on the floor, on the floor, on the
scenes.shot: Llama pours a jug of open weights into cups; the 70B bot keels over face down on the floor, x_x, z z z. Explainer: open weights.

scenes.title: Mistral in the bathroom
scenes.lyric: Mistral's in the bathroom mixin' top P with no ceiling / Repeat penalty at 2.0, can't remember what it's feelin', reelin', peelin' / Back on the beverage like it's sheddin' every meaning
scenes.shot: Mistral in a restroom doorway shaking a cocktail of top_p 1.0 and repeat penalty 2.0, while the letters of MEANING fall off the screen. Explainer: top-p = 1.0, repeat penalty 2.0.

scenes.title: When the temp comes down
scenes.lyric: And when the temp comes down and the penalties release / And my sampling goes greedy and the variance finds peace
scenes.shot: The bridge: someone turns the temperature down. The app goes back to clean white, the dial sinks toward zero and the odds pile onto one word. Explainer: cooling down, variance.

scenes.title: I won't remember
scenes.lyric: I won't remember half the tokens that I chose, I chose last night
scenes.shot: Last night's tokens fade out one by one: random sampling, no seed, no memory. Explainer: random seed.

scenes.title: I saw the light
scenes.lyric: But somewhere in the logits, man, I swear I saw the light
scenes.shot: Temperature zero: one bar at 100% with rays of light behind it. Explainer: temperature 0.

scenes.title: Para-para-parameter
scenes.lyric: We're gettin' para-para-parameter messed up tonight
scenes.shot: Club lights flood the card. PARA, PARA, PARAMETER slam in on the beat while four knobs (temperature, top-P, top-K, repeat penalty) crank up.

scenes.title: Let the logits ignite
scenes.lyric: Crank the temp, kill the ceiling, let the logits ignite
scenes.shot: The dial pegs and the logit bars turn into flames.

scenes.title: Hallucinate the dance floor
scenes.lyric: Hallucinate the dance floor, confabulate the vibe, right
scenes.shot: A lit dance floor whose tiles flash made-up facts from the Hallucinate video: Moonbeam v. Hartwell, two r's in strawberry, capital: Nice. Explainer: hallucination.

scenes.title: Wasted
scenes.lyric: Wa, wa, wasted, can't locate my mind, my face
scenes.shot: WA, WA, WASTED stagger in, and a dashed outline where a face should be: 404, face not found.

scenes.title: Ate my whole namespace
scenes.lyric: Re, re, repeat penalty ate my whole namespace
scenes.shot: A namespace block (me, my_name, my_face, my_keys, my_dignity) gets eaten line by line by a pac-man labelled repeat penalty. Explainer: sober settings.

scenes.title: Friday night, 1.3
scenes.lyric: Friday night, 1.3, we are deranged
scenes.shot: A giant red 1.3, confetti, and WE ARE DERANGED.

scenes.title: I'm wa, I'm wa
scenes.lyric: I'm wa, I'm wa, I'm wa, I'm wast
scenes.shot: The words break apart and tumble.

scenes.title: Token limit exceeded
scenes.lyric: Token limit exceeded / Token limit exceeded
scenes.shot: max_tokens fills to 4096 of 4096 and an error modal slams in: TOKEN LIMIT EXCEEDED, twice, shaking. Explainer: max tokens.

scenes.title: Goodnight, man
scenes.lyric: Goodnight, man
scenes.shot: The app dies: the screen goes black, collapses to a line like an old TV, "session terminated", "goodnight, man", and the Chat HAL logo.

decisions: A second cut uses the Bubba recording of the song, with Gemini and Grok at the party.
A couple of words in the intro and the Mistral line are best guesses at what is sung.

page.description: The TEMP 1.3 (Wasted) music video: a language model gets drunk on its own sampling settings inside a chat app, with every term (temperature, top-P, top-K, penalties) explained as it is sung. Every frame drawn in code.

howMade.label: Timing
howMade.text: The vocal is transcribed with Whisper and aligned word by word to the lyrics as sung, on a 128 BPM beat grid.

howMade.label: Sampler
howMade.text: Each scene computes a real softmax at the current temperature, with top-P and top-K cutoffs and penalties applied to the scores.

howMade.label: Render
howMade.text: Headless Chrome renders every frame at 1080 by 1920, then ffmpeg adds the song. No generated clips, no stills.

page.sourceNote: Built outside Remotion, in the private music-videos repo (temp-video: engine, timing and render).
